title: Nexcess Review 2026: Now Liquid Web, Plans and Pricing
excerpt: Nexcess managed WordPress starts at $19 a month with email, staging and migration included. Here is how it relates to Liquid Web, what each plan costs, how it tested and who should look elsewhere.

meta._yoast_wpseo_title: Nexcess Review 2026: Now Liquid Web, Plans and Pricing
meta._yoast_wpseo_metadesc: Nexcess review for 2026: Nexcess is now part of Liquid Web. See plans, prices, what each plan includes, WordPress features and who it suits, with setup steps.
meta.rl_answer: Nexcess is managed WordPress hosting, now part of Liquid Web. Plans start at $19 a month for one site and include email, staging and migration. There are no data centers in Asia.
meta.rl_faqs:
Is Nexcess now Liquid Web? | In practice, yes. Nexcess and Liquid Web announced in February 2024 that they would become one brand, and in April 2026 the hosting arm was renamed Liquid Web by Nexcess. The managed WordPress plans are the same product on both sites.
How much does Nexcess hosting cost? | On Nexcess's plan page on 20 November 2026, Pro WordPress was from $19 a month and Elite from $29, for one site with up to 50,000 visits. Annual billing takes 10% off. Prices rise with each visit tier.
What resources are included with Nexcess hosting plans? | Every plan has a firewall, Object Cache Pro, an edge CDN, a staging site and a development site, free SSL, email hosting and 24/7/365 support. Pro has 20 GB for one site and 14 days of backups. Elite has 40 GB and 30 days.
Does Nexcess include email hosting? | Yes. Nexcess lists email hosting in the included features of every managed WordPress plan.
Does Nexcess offer WooCommerce hosting? | Yes. Its Sites and Stores pages list WooCommerce, Magento and Shopware hosting, and its managed WordPress plans run WooCommerce. Test checkout on your own data, because Webhostingcat saw a slow checkout on Liquid Web.
What are the best Nexcess plans for Magento hosting? | Nexcess lists Magento hosting on its Sites and Stores pages, but HostingEngines found no public prices, only a chat button. Ask Nexcess for a quote based on your catalog and traffic.
What kind of cloud hosting does Nexcess offer? | Its parent, Liquid Web, sells managed WordPress, VPS, cloud, dedicated and bare metal hosting. This page covers the managed WordPress plans.
Does Nexcess have a money-back guarantee? | The plan page does not state one. Website Planet reported 30 days. Ask Nexcess in chat before you buy and read the terms in your cart.
Does Nexcess cost more at renewal? | The plan page shows one price and no renewal figure. Real Tool Stack notes that the terms allow price increases with 30 days' notice. Read the renewal terms in your order summary.
Is Nexcess fast? | Yes in independent tests. Webhostingcat measured a 202 ms time to first byte and a 433 ms Largest Contentful Paint, and two testers saw 0% errors at 1,000 concurrent users. First-byte times reached 1.9 seconds from India.
Is Nexcess good for WordPress? | Yes for business sites and stores with visitors in the US, UK or Australia. It includes staging, Object Cache Pro, an edge CDN and human-assisted migration.
Does Nexcess have phone support? | The plan page lists 24/7/365 support but no phone line. Website Planet reported chat connecting immediately and a ticket answered in 15 minutes.
Is Nexcess better than Kinsta? | Nexcess costs less, at $19 against $35 for one site, and includes email. Kinsta has a renewal price that stays the same and a free first month for new customers. Compare them at your own traffic.

meta.rl_takeaways:
Pro is $19 a month and Elite $29 for one site with up to 50,000 visits (Nexcess, 20 Nov 2026).
Email hosting, staging, Object Cache Pro and an edge CDN are in every plan.
Two testers saw 0% errors at 1,000 concurrent users.
The plan page states no renewal price and no money-back window.
meta.rl_r_verdict: Nexcess is a good fit for business sites and stores that serve the US, UK or Australia and want email, staging and migration included. Check the renewal terms and refund window before you pay. Look elsewhere if your visitors are mostly in Asia.
meta.rl_r_buy:
You run a business site or WooCommerce store with US, UK or Australian visitors.
You want email, staging and migration included.
You want a simple price by sites and visits.
meta.rl_r_skip:
Most of your visitors are in Asia.
You want a refund window and renewal price stated on the page.
You want the lowest price for a small site.
meta.rl_r_pros:
Email, staging, Object Cache Pro and an edge CDN on every plan.
0% errors at 1,000 users in two tests.
Human-assisted migration on every plan.
30 days of backups on Elite.
Annual billing 10% off.
meta.rl_r_cons:
No data centers in Asia.
No renewal price or refund window on the plan page.
Checkout was slow in one store test.
Prices rise with each visit tier.
Brand changes make plans harder to find.
meta.rl_r_best: Business sites and stores with US, UK or Australian visitors
meta.rl_r_method:
Our own use | We do not host our own site on Nexcess, so this is a research-based review. We did not run our own tests
Pricing and plan limits | Nexcess's managed WordPress plan page, read on 20 November 2026, with the price ladder checked against HostingEngines (5 November 2026)
Independent tests | Webhostingcat (April 2026), Sayan Samanta (February 2026) and Website Planet (March 2026)
Competitor reviews | The top-ranking Nexcess reviews read for structure and questions: HostingEngines, Real Tool Stack, HostingAlmanac and HowToHosting
Questions people ask | The questions the top pages answer in their headings, plus the questions people search for in Semrush, such as what resources the plans include and whether Nexcess offers WooCommerce and Magento hosting
When sources disagree | We show both views and say which we used. For storage on the entry plan the sources say 15 GB and 20 GB, so we show both
Our calculations | We did not calculate cost tables because the plan page states no renewal price
Freshness | Prices are read again before this page goes live, and the page carries the date they were checked
What we did not do | We did not run our own speed or uptime test. Each test number is credited to the team that measured it

meta.rl_r_final: Nexcess gives business sites managed WordPress with email, staging and migration included. Check the renewal terms and refund window before you pay, and pick a data center close to your visitors.
